styles.css: /* wp-ja-essence: dark mode. The source (JA Essence, Joomla 6 T4) follows the OS until the visitor picks: its head script sets html[data-theme] from prefers-color-scheme, the .ja-theme-toggle button switches it (css/darkmode.css). Here every colour preset carries both halves through light-dark(): light = tokens.css (measured 01/10 on the source stand), dark = the source's --dm-* block (css/darkmode.css: bg #11151f, band #161b27, surface #1a2130, border #2b3548, text #c2c9d6, heading #eef1f6, muted #8c97a8, accent #4d6bff, accent hover #7d93ff), each read back as computed style in the design contract (desktop-dark). No attribute = auto, the OS decides; assets/js/wp-ja-essence-dark.js writes data-theme light|dark from the tracy_theme cookie before the first paint. */ :root{color-scheme:light dark;--wp--preset--color--bg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-bg, #f8f8ff),var(--ds-c-bg, #11151f));--wp--preset--color--surface:light-dark(var(--ds-c-surface, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-surface, #1a2130));--wp--preset--color--surface-warm:light-dark(var(--ds-c-surface-warm, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-surface-warm, #161b27));--wp--preset--color--fg:light-dark(var(--ds-c-fg, rgba(37,36,36,0.7)),var(--ds-c-fg, #c2c9d6));--wp--preset--color--fg-2:light-dark(var(--ds-c-heading, #212529),var(--ds-c-heading, #eef1f6));--wp--preset--color--muted:light-dark(var(--ds-c-muted, #6c757d),var(--ds-c-muted, #8c97a8));--wp--preset--color--meta:light-dark(var(--ds-c-meta, #86868b),var(--ds-c-meta, #8c97a8));--wp--preset--color--border:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border, rgba(0,0,0,0.125)),var(--ds-c-border, #2b3548));--wp--preset--color--border-soft:light-dark(var(--ds-c-border-soft, #e8e8ed),var(--ds-c-border-soft, #2b3548));--wp--preset--color--accent:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent, #4d6bff),var(--ds-c-accent, #4d6bff));--wp--preset--color--accent-on:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff),var(--ds-c-accent-on, #ffffff));--wp--preset--color--accent-hover:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #1a3eed),var(--ds-c-accent-hover, #7d93ff));--wp--preset--color--accent-active:light-dark(var(--ds-c-accent-active, #1a3eed),var(--ds-c-accent-active, #7d93ff));}:root[data-theme="light"]{color-scheme:light}:root[data-theme="dark"]{color-scheme:dark}
